# SpriteBatchShapeExtensions

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Graphics` · class

```csharp
public static class SpriteBatchShapeExtensions
```

Plain shapes in a sprite batch, in order with its sprites, for debug drawing and simple games. Shapes have hard edges unless the game's `PreferredMultisampleCount` smooths them.

## Remarks

A rectangle or a line costs what a sprite does, and a filled shape what a sprite does for each triangle: a circle has about 20 sides at a radius of 40, and an outlined one twice that. For many circles, draw a circle sprite. Shapes use a texture of their own, so drawing them between sprites from another texture ends the batch's run of sprites each time: draw them together where you can.

### FillTriangles

```csharp
public static void FillTriangles(this SpriteBatch spriteBatch, ReadOnlySpan<Vertex> vertices)
```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`Vertex`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Vertex.md)

Fills triangles, three vertices each, with their vertices' colors, blended across each one. It's [`SpriteBatch.DrawTriangles`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md#drawtriangles) without a texture, so vertices' texture coordinates don't matter.

**Throws `ArgumentException`:** The number of vertices isn't a multiple of three.

```csharp
public static void FillTriangles(this SpriteBatch spriteBatch, ReadOnlySpan<Vertex> vertices, ReadOnlySpan<ushort> indices)
```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`Vertex`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Vertex.md)

Fills triangles from a list of vertices that they share, three indices each, with their vertices' colors, blended across each one. It's [`SpriteBatch.DrawTriangles`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md#drawtriangles) without a texture, so vertices' texture coordinates don't matter.

**Throws `ArgumentException`:** The number of indices isn't a multiple of three.
